why: the RAII token that removes a waitable from its wait set on drop. rclrs's wait-set machinery; the reason is stated in full at `cpp:WaitSet`. static entity storage: the executor's entity table is an arena sized at compile time (`NROS_EXECUTOR_MAX_HANDLES`) with no allocator behind it, and a `HandleId` is an index into it. Registration is one-way -- no slot is ever reclaimed and no handle is ever invalidated.
